description: Procedure parameters with DEFAULT values: an INTEGER or VARCHAR default lets the parameter be omitted at CALL, a mix of required and defaulted parameters accepts both the short and the full call, omitting a REQUIRED parameter is refused, and a defaulted parameter still shows up in SHOW PROCEDURES' arguments signature. Converted 1:1 from features/ProcedureDefaultParamsTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE add_rows(n INTEGER DEFAULT 1) RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 'ok'; END $$
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE greet(name VARCHAR DEFAULT 'World') RETURNS VARCHAR LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN RETURN 'hello'; END $$
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE compute(x INTEGER, y INTEGER DEFAULT 10) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN RETURN x; END $$
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE strict_proc(x INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN RETURN x; END $$
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE with_default(i INTEGER DEFAULT 0) RETURNS INTEGER LANGUAGE SQL AS $$ BEGIN RETURN i; END $$
